label: WRONG
reason: Request/response schemas end in Schema (get-user, find-documents), but the only outliers are a shared enum sub-schema (ZAdminRoleSelection, which has its own TAdminRoleSelection type) and a numeric constant; both are legitimately different kinds of thing, so 0 of 2 counted are mistakes and new constants would be flagged wrongly. Hesitated with ACCEPT (the enum arguably should be *Schema); no naming lint rule in biome.json.
